svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI INFRASTRUCTURE · DIFFUSION LLM (dLLM) VS. AUTOREGRESSIVE PARADIGM (#382)
Block Diffusion LLM (LLaDA / Mercury / BD3) vs. Serial Autoregressive Decode
Refining 64–256 Masked Tokens in Parallel Shifts Decode From HBM-Bandwidth-Bound to TensorCore-Compute-Bound (980 TPS)
• Generates 512 tokens strictly 1 token at a time (512 HBM weight reads)
• Arithmetic Intensity = 1..2 FLOPs/B (99% of TensorCores sit idle!)
• Causal left-to-right mask suffers on bidirectional infilling (62.5%)
• Capped at 110 TPS/User (4,654 ms to generate 512 code tokens)
Tier 4: Block Diffusion (BD3 / Mercury) + KV Cache
• Caches 4K Prompt + Past Blocks via exact Causal Prefix KV Cache
• Denoises 64-token blocks in parallel in 6–12 TensorCore steps!
• Confidence-adaptive early unmasking freezes easy syntax in 2 steps
• 980 TPS/User (522 ms for 512 tokens — 8.9x Faster Than Serial AR!)
4-Tier Generation Paradigm Matrix (512-Token Code/JSON Output · 4K Prompt · 1x H100)
Tier 1 (Serial Autoregressive AR) : User TPS = 110.0 | 512-Tok E2E = 4654ms | KV Cache = Yes | Infill = 62.5%
Tier 2 (AR + EAGLE-3 Speculative) : User TPS = 285.0 | 512-Tok E2E = 1796ms | KV Cache = Yes | Infill = 62.5%
Tier 3 (Vanilla Full-Seq dLLM LLaDA): User TPS = 640.0 | 512-Tok E2E = 800ms | KV Cache = No | Infill = 94.2%
Tier 4 (Block Diffusion + KV Cache) : User TPS = 980.0 | 512-Tok E2E = 522ms | KV Cache = Yes | Infill = 93.8%
